description: Build the source pack for an artifact: a deterministic, sorted extract of the types, elements, taxonomies and relations in scope, plus a stamp with its packHash. Write the artifact only from this pack, then call check_grounding with the pack, the stamp and your output. The packHash is the version pin. Read-only; nothing is stored.

provenanceNote.description: Optional note stamped into provenance, for example 'pre-product bridge: rendered outside CoreModels from gated output'

templateId.description: Template id from list_artifact_templates, e.g. data-dictionary.

typeIds.description: Optional type node ids; omit for every type in scope (optionally within spaceId).

name: build_source_pack
title: Build Source Pack
